pages.text: The sky is a volatile and unpredictable place. Your transport fleet is completely at the mercy of atmospheric conditions. While clear skies offer gentle breezes, severe weather changes everything.

pages.title: Weather Conditions:
pages.text: $(2)Clear Skies:$() Calm currents, ideal for standard, safe shipments.$(br)$(4)Rain:$() Generates moderate turbulence and accelerates balloon wear.$(br)$(4)Thunderstorms:$() Violent gales and lightning risk; highly dangerous for fragile cargo.

pages.title: Tailwinds:
pages.text: Traveling in the same direction as the wind current catches the balloon's canvas, granting a massive $(2)Speed Boost$() that shortens travel time significantly.

pages.title: Headwinds:
pages.text: Forcing your hauler to fly directly against strong opposing winds results in a severe $(4)Speed Penalty$(), dragging down efficiency and burning through valuable trip durability.

pages.title: Wind Direction
pages.text: Always check the wind direction with your Wind Vane before launching heavy shipments to ensure you fly with the currents rather than against them.

pages.title: Altitude Dynamics:
pages.text: Wind currents change depending on the elevation of your departure dock:$(br)$(2)High Peaks (Y > 128):$() Exposes your hauler to powerful upper atmospheric streams, boosting all wind effects by $(2)50%$().$(br)$(4)Low Valleys (Y < 60):$() Mountains and terrain block the breeze, cutting the wind's influence by $(4)50%$().
